title: RevocationsPublishedFeed
description: Registry-signed envelope returned by GET /v1/revocations/published. Lists every revocation the Registry has published, ordered by revoked_at DESC. The signature MUST be verified against the Registry's identity key (advertised at /.well-known/handshake/did.json) before any field of the body is trusted, since the response is served unauthenticated and may traverse caches.

version.description: Envelope version. Bumps when the envelope shape changes incompatibly.

issuer_did.description: The Registry's DID. Verifiers resolve this to the verification key used to check `signature.value`.

as_of.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at which the Registry assembled this snapshot.

revocations.description: Published revocations, ordered by revoked_at DESC with a stable tiebreaker on id DESC.

next_cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; null when the snapshot fits in one response.

value.description: base64url (no padding) of the Ed25519 signature over JCS(envelope without the `signature` field).

id.description: Opaque Registry-assigned revocation id (UUID in the reference implementation).

subject_did.description: The DID whose key/credential is being revoked.

key_id.description: Verification-method fragment within the subject's DID Document, e.g. `#org-2026`.

reason.description: Operator-supplied short reason. May be empty.

revoked_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp at which the revocation took effect.

tree_head_id.description: Registry tree-head id under which this revocation was anchored. Verifiers cross-check this against the inclusion proof.
